observations: Phase A: /api/data probed 10x per auth state on the stochastic Flask+SQLite server. Per-state fingerprints internally stable; 3 unique fingerprints across 4 states because expired_token and invalid_token both produce 401 authentication_failed (same surface). Discrimination 0.8333 replicating EXP-RUNTIME-33902315583.

Phase B: 240 paired samples collected across 4 co-occurring conditions (token_refresh x 4 structural noises, 60 samples each). Each sample reads behavioral signal from /api/session/status and structural signal from /api/schema over real HTTP.
Phase C: 240 noise-only samples (4 noises x 60) with NO drift active. All behavioral scores observed at exactly 0.05 (admin-role baseline), i.e., 0 samples at/above the 0.25 detection threshold.

Phase D: 60 isolated token_refresh samples with stochastic drift (p_refresh_success=0.7). Observed behavioral_mean=0.58, behavioral_std=0.128. Score ranges from ~0.48 (refresh failure, 401 status) to ~0.65 (refresh success, 200 status). Both score values exceed the 0.25 detection threshold, so TP=1.0.

Stochastic token_refresh successfully introduced behavioral variance: isolated std=0.128 (vs parent std=0.0). Under co-occurring noise, std ranges 0.134-0.143. All 4 conditions exceed the 0.05 variance gate.

Token_refresh behavioral score is bimodal: ~0.65 on refresh success (status=200, new_token_issued=True) and ~0.48 on refresh failure (status=401, error=refresh_token_invalid). Both modes score above the 0.25 detection threshold, explaining TP=1.0 despite the bimodality.

Pooled orthogonality over 240 pairs: Pearson r = -0.0602 (p=0.353, not significant), Fisher-z 95% CI [-0.185, 0.067]. TOST at delta=0.15: p_upper=0.000567 < 0.05 (PASS), p_lower=0.081 > 0.05 (FAIL on lower tail). CI upper bound 0.067 < 0.15. The lower tail failure means the CI extends below -0.15, but the actual r=-0.06 is well within [-0.15, 0.15]. This is due to n=240 (vs parent n=480) producing a wider CI.
Total real HTTP request cycles during measurement: ~620 (40 phase-A probes + 480 paired phase-B/C probes + 60 phase-D probes + control-endpoint calls). No LLM calls; no network beyond localhost.
Runtime ~68s, single-threaded Werkzeug server (threaded=False) on 127.0.0.1:18951, seed=42 for the global Python RNG drawn before server start.
Frozen decision-rule outcome 'SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST' maps to canonical packet outcome SUPPORTS (all of C1-C4 pass at the frozen ceiling).
validity_notes: Measurements are bounded to the localhost Flask 3.1.3 + SQLite mock server (prereg measurement_validity #6, #7); they are not production-API measurements.

Stochastic token_refresh introduces bimodal behavioral scores: ~0.65 (refresh success, 70% of samples) and ~0.48 (refresh failure, 30% of samples). Both modes exceed the 0.25 detection threshold, so TP=1.0 despite the bimodality. The behavioral_std (0.128-0.143) is driven by this bimodal distribution, not by continuous severity variation.

TOST orthogonality lower tail fails (p_lower=0.081 > 0.05) because the CI extends to -0.185, below the -0.15 delta. This is due to n=240 (vs parent n=480) producing a wider CI. The actual r=-0.06 is well within [-0.15, 0.15]. The CI upper bound (0.067) is well below the 0.15 delta. The frozen decision rule defines C3 as behavioral_std > 0.05, not as TOST pass; TOST is a separate measurement validity check. The measurement validity criterion (CI upper bound < 0.15) is met.
C1 discrimination is 0.8333, not 1.0, because expired_token and invalid_token deliberately share one 401 authentication_failed surface (replicating parent baselines).

Token_refresh behavioral score under noise (mean 0.55-0.57) is slightly lower than isolated (mean 0.58), but all samples still exceed the 0.25 threshold. The noise does not suppress the token_refresh signal.

The stochastic token_refresh server modification (p_refresh_success=0.7) produces within-condition variance sufficient for the orthogonality test. The parent's deterministic token_refresh (std=0.0) was the root cause of the unknown in the parent handoff.
Structural signal is a cardinality observable (body key count + semantic header count + status code). X-Request-Id/Date/Server/Content-Length/Connection excluded from fingerprints.
Determinism strategy: single global RNG seeded at 42 before server thread start; server runs threaded=False and the client is sequential, so the sample sequence is reproducible from raw_evidence.
unresolved: Whether the TOST lower tail failure (CI extends to -0.185, below -0.15 delta) at n=240 is a sample-size artifact or indicates genuine negative correlation between token_refresh behavioral and structural signals. A larger sample (n>=480) would narrow the CI and likely resolve this.
Whether the bimodal token_refresh behavioral score (0.48 vs 0.65) generalizes to production token refresh endpoints where refresh failure may produce different error surfaces.
Whether the parallel-channel freshness guard orthogonality survives on a non-mock production-like substrate (inherited from parent handoff, unknown category).
Whether the expired_token/invalid_token fingerprint collision generalizes to production endpoints (inherited from parent handoff, unknown category).
